name: Pagination
intro: Place List inside Root. Use PrevTrigger, NextTrigger, Item, Ellipsis, or the Pages shortcut to build page navigation.

props.name: currentPage
props.description: Initial page or controlled page when onPageChange is supplied.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Receives page changes; supply currentPage to control the state.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders items directly or from computed page slots.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: Wraps a button by default. Button props and page-state attributes apply to that inner button; render can replace it with a custom control.

parts.name: Ellipsis
parts.description: Marks a gap in the visible page sequence.

parts.name: Pages
parts.description: Renders Item and Ellipsis parts from the computed page sequence.
